findings.message: Row 7, column SEO Title: SEO title is 84 characters. The documented limit is 70.
Row 8, column Variant Price: Price is blank. The current column table says the default is 0.00. The older troubleshooting page lists "Validation failed: price can't be blank".
Row 10, column Variant Compare At Price: compare-at price 9.99 is not higher than price 9.99. The compare-at price has to be higher than the price to display a sale.
Row 12, column Variant Price: "12,50" is not a plain number such as 9.99 or .99. Only a currency symbol or letters are documented as invalid, so this shape is a warning.
Row 13, column Handle: "Trail Water Bottle" contains a space. A valid URL handle can contain letters, dashes, and numbers, but it can't contain spaces.
Row 17, column Option1 Value: Option1 value is "6ft" and this product never sets Option1 name. The help pages do not say the importer rejects this.
Row 18, column Title: handle "slow-feeder-bowl" has no Title. The importer ignores a line that has a handle and no product title.
Row 19, column Option1 Value: Option1 value is "XL" and this product never sets Option1 name. The help pages do not say the importer rejects this.
Row 19, column Title: handle "calming-collar-xl" has no Title. The importer ignores a line that has a handle and no product title.

Row 20, column Handle: URL handle "corrugated-cat-scratcher" already appeared in an earlier product. Keep every row for a product together. If rows with the same URL handle are separated by other products, the later rows are not imported as variants.
